stem: For laptops sold to business customers in Q3, Voltmarkt's discount depth was 8.0%: discounts on the invoice took 8% of list value. Volume rebates paid after the quarter came to another 3% of list value. Price realisation is the share of list value Voltmarkt keeps after on-invoice discounts and off-invoice rebates. What was the price realisation on these sales? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
